---
format:
  typst:
    papersize: a4
    margin:
      top: 6mm
      bottom: 6mm
      left: 7.5mm
      right: 7.5mm
---

```{=typst}
#set document(title: "Form 4: Archaeological Photographic Recording Log", author: "Balala Heritage Project")
#set text(font: ("Helvetica", "Arial"), size: 7.2pt, spacing: 100%)
#set par(leading: 0.28em, justify: false)

// Reusable 7.5mm handwriting ergonomic primitives
#let cb = box(width: 7.2pt, height: 7.2pt, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#222222"), radius: 1pt, baseline: 1pt)

#let write-box(w: 100%) = box(
  width: w,
  height: 7.5mm,
  stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#555555"), thickness: 0.55pt, dash: "dotted"))
)

#let labeled-line(lbl, w: 100%) = box(width: w, height: 7.5mm)[
  #align(bottom)[
    #grid(
      columns: (auto, 1fr),
      gutter: 4pt,
      align: bottom,
      [#text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#222222"), size: 7.5pt)[#lbl]],
      [#box(width: 100%, height: 7.5mm, stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#555555"), thickness: 0.55pt, dash: "dotted")))]
    )
  ]
]

#let comment-line() = block(
  width: 100%,
  height: 7.5mm,
  spacing: 0pt,
  stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#555555"), thickness: 0.55pt, dash: "dotted"))
)

#let comments-block(n: 3, label: "Additional Comments / Lighting, Backup & Processing Notes:") = block(
  width: 100%,
  above: 2.5pt,
  below: 1pt,
  [
    #text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#1b365d"), size: 7.1pt)[#label]
    #for i in range(n) { comment-line() }
  ]
)

#let sec-bar(num, title) = block(
  width: 100%,
  fill: rgb("#1b365d"),
  inset: (x: 4.5pt, y: 1.6pt),
  radius: 1.2pt,
  spacing: 0pt,
  [
    #grid(
      columns: (auto, 1fr),
      gutter: 6pt,
      text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 8.2pt)[#num],
      text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 8.2pt)[#title]
    )
  ]
)

#let field-lbl(txt) = text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#222222"), size: 7.2pt)[#txt]
#let note(txt) = text(fill: rgb("#444444"), size: 6.5pt, style: "italic")[#txt]

// Form 4 Banner
#block(
  width: 100%,
  stroke: 0.8pt + rgb("#1b365d"),
  fill: rgb("#f4f6f9"),
  inset: (x: 5pt, y: 2.2pt),
  radius: 1.5pt,
  [
    #grid(
      columns: (1fr, auto),
      gutter: 8pt,
      [
        #text(weight: "bold", size: 9.8pt, fill: rgb("#1b365d"))[FORM 4: PHOTOGRAPHIC RECORDING LOG] \
        #text(size: 6.7pt, fill: rgb("#333333"))[
          Archaeological Photo Register | Adapted from Burke, Smith & Morrison (2020) Appendix 3.12 & Miles Lewis (1992)
        ]
      ],
      [
        #align(right + top)[
          #text(weight: "bold", size: 8.5pt, fill: rgb("#1b365d"))[BALALA HERITAGE PROJECT] \
          #text(size: 6.8pt, fill: rgb("#555555"))[FORM 4 — SINGLE / REPEATABLE]
        ]
      ]
    )
  ]
)
#v(1.2pt)

// Standardized ID Coding Guide
#block(
  width: 100%,
  fill: rgb("#e8eef5"),
  stroke: 0.5pt + rgb("#1b365d"),
  inset: (x: 5pt, y: 2.0pt),
  radius: 1.2pt,
  [
    #text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#1b365d"), size: 6.8pt)[ID CODING GUIDE:] #text(size: 6.8pt, fill: rgb("#222222"))[Link all photos to Master Site Map & Plans. #strong[Structure ID:] `STR-01` | #strong[Room ID]: `STR-01-A` | #strong[Object ID]: `STR-01-A-01` | #strong[Landscape/Site]: `SITE-01`. Mark photo position and facing angle arrow (`➔`) on Floor / Site Plan.]
  ]
)
#v(1.2pt)

// Field Photography Protocol Banner
#block(
  width: 100%,
  fill: rgb("#fff9e6"),
  stroke: 0.55pt + rgb("#c48b00"),
  inset: (x: 5pt, y: 2.2pt),
  radius: 1.2pt,
  [
    #text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#8a5a00"), size: 6.8pt)[MANDATORY PHOTOGRAPHIC INSTRUCTIONS:] #text(size: 6.6pt, fill: rgb("#222222"))[
      1. #strong[ONE CAMERA PER FORM:] Strictly use one camera body and memory card per recording sheet. Never mix frames from multiple cameras on the same form.
      2. #strong[METRIC SCALES:] Always place an appropriate photographic scale (2m ranging pole for building elevations; 1m/50cm scale for wall sections; 20cm/10cm scale for joinery, mason marks, graffiti, or artifacts) parallel to the camera sensor. Do not obscure key fabric details.
      3. #strong[NORTH ARROW (OUTDOOR SHOTS):] For all outdoor structural elevations, landscape context shots, and external features, place a north arrow pointing north to verify orientation. Record camera facing direction (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW, or Down/Up).
    ]
  ]
)

#v(1.5pt)
// SECTION 1: PHOTO LOG HEADER & METADATA
#sec-bar("SECTION 1", "PHOTOGRAPHIC REGISTER HEADER & CAMERA METADATA")
#v(1.5pt)

#grid(
  columns: (1.2fr, 1.4fr, 1fr, 0.9fr),
  row-gutter: 2pt, column-gutter: 6pt,
  labeled-line("Property / Site Name:"),
  labeled-line("Structure ID / Context (e.g. STR-01):"),
  labeled-line("Date (DD/MM/YYYY):"),
  labeled-line("Sheet No.:")
)

#grid(
  columns: (1.3fr, 1.1fr, 1.1fr, 1fr),
  row-gutter: 2pt, column-gutter: 6pt,
  labeled-line("Photographer(s) (Full Names):"),
  labeled-line("Camera Make, Model & ID:"),
  labeled-line("Card / Roll / Folder ID:"),
  labeled-line("Site / Floor Plan Sheet No.:")
)

#v(2.0pt)
// SECTION 2: PHOTOGRAPHIC REGISTER TABLE
#sec-bar("SECTION 2", "PHOTOGRAPHIC REGISTER TABLE")
#v(1.0pt)
#note([*Table Guidelines:* Assign Photo ID (camera frame No. or range for brackets). List Component Code (e.g. STR-01-EXT-N, STR-01-A, STR-01-A-01). Note Camera Facing Orientation (e.g. Facing N, E, Down, Up). Indicate Scale Size and whether North Arrow was included. Provide full descriptive caption.])
#v(1.5pt)

#table(
  columns: (64pt, 74pt, 54pt, 64pt, 1fr),
  stroke: 0.45pt + rgb("#bbbbbb"),
  fill: (col, row) => if row == 0 { rgb("#e8eef5") } else { none },
  inset: (x: 3.5pt, y: 2.2pt),
  align: (col, row) => if row == 0 { center + horizon } else { left + horizon },
  // Header row
  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#1b365d"), size: 7.0pt)[Photo ID / \ Frame No(s).]],
  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#1b365d"), size: 7.0pt)[Component Code \ (e.g. STR-01-A)]],
  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#1b365d"), size: 7.0pt)[Orientation / \ Facing Dir]],
  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#1b365d"), size: 7.0pt)[Scale & North \ Arrow Used?]],
  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#1b365d"), size: 7.0pt)[Photo Subject, Caption & Architectural / Archaeological Description]],
  // 14 Photo rows at 7.5mm height
  ..range(14).map(i => (
    [#box(width: 100%, height: 7.5mm, stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#666666"), thickness: 0.5pt, dash: "dotted")))],
    [#box(width: 100%, height: 7.5mm, stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#666666"), thickness: 0.5pt, dash: "dotted")))],
    [#box(width: 100%, height: 7.5mm, stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#666666"), thickness: 0.5pt, dash: "dotted")))],
    [#box(width: 100%, height: 7.5mm, stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#666666"), thickness: 0.5pt, dash: "dotted")))],
    [#box(width: 100%, height: 7.5mm, stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#666666"), thickness: 0.5pt, dash: "dotted")))]
  )).flatten()
)

#v(1.0pt)
#block(
  width: 100%,
  fill: rgb("#f4f6f9"),
  stroke: 0.4pt + rgb("#cccccc"),
  inset: (x: 4.5pt, y: 2.0pt),
  radius: 1.0pt,
  [
    #field-lbl("Controlled Codes & Conventions:") #text(size: 6.6pt, fill: rgb("#333333"))[
      #strong[Facing/Orientation:] N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW, Down (Plan/Floor), Up (Ceiling/Roof framing), Oblique (Perspective). \
      #strong[Scale Types:] 2m pole, 1m scale, 50cm scale, 20cm scale, 10cm scale, Micro scale (1cm), None. \
      #strong[North Arrow:] NA = North Arrow in shot (mandatory for outdoor contextual/elevation shots); No NA = Not in shot (e.g. macro close-ups).
    ]
  ]
)

#v(1.5pt)
// SECTION 3: ADDITIONAL COMMENTS & ARCHIVE NOTES
#sec-bar("SECTION 3", "ADDITIONAL COMMENTS, LIGHTING & ARCHIVE BACKUP NOTES")
#comments-block(n: 3, label: "Additional Comments / Harsh Lighting, Storage Media & Archive Ingestion Notes:")
```
